Position Overview As a Staff AI Application Engineer in the Model Enablement team (Application Software), you will build our model enablement platform and decide how each model runs across the Metis or Europa AIPU, the host CPU and the host's accelerators. How this work is split and scheduled determines most of the end-to-end performance a customer sees in the Voyager SDK. The role combines architecture and hands-on work across the model frontend, the graph compiler, the runtime and the application pipeline. During model bring-up, you cover the frontend and graph side, and a device-side engineer covers the backend. Our team uses AI coding agents in daily work, and you will use them to build, test and verify your own work. We also welcome experienced field application engineers, technical leads and engineering managers who want to return to hands-on engineering. Experience in planning, delegating and reviewing work transfers well to working with AI agents. Key responsibilities: Model enablement platform and agent harness: Build the platform that engineers and AI agents use to bring up models: reusable tools to partition, compile, run and profile; environments with access to real hardware; closed-loop runs that apply a change, measure it against the reference and repeat; and verification (differential testing, regression detection) integrated into CI. Model ingestion: Own how a PyTorch or ONNX model is captured, analysed and split across the AIPU's matrix and RISC-V vector units, the host CPU and the host's accelerators (GPU, NPU, video decoder), with placement tags that users can read and override. Build this with the graph compiler team so it works for every model. Heterogeneous execution: Extend that split to large models, cascades and multi-model pipelines, for example with expert offloading and caching across device and host memory. Agree the plan with the graph compiler team. End-to-end performance: With the application team (pipeline builder) and the runtime team, bring each model to its best end-to-end performance: overlap of host and device work, zero-copy buffers, batching, multi-core scheduling, and models with several inputs. Profile device time, host time and data movement, and confirm each speedup in the full pipeline. Critical models: Study the models that matter most to customers, on Metis today and on Europa, and turn each lesson into a platform improvement. Qualifications: Essential 8+ years of engineering experience in systems, compilers, runtimes or performance, including system-level design ownership. Hands-on experience with heterogeneous computing across CPU, GPU, DSP, NPU or FPGA, including reasoning about compute, memory bandwidth, latency and data movement. Solid fundamentals in computer architecture, operating systems and parallel programming. Familiarity with ML graph representations and compiler concepts: graph capture (torch.export, FX, ONNX), lowering, operator fusion, partitioning, memory planning. Strong C++ and Python. Daily use of AI coding agents on real engineering work, with the judgment to review and test their output. Preferred Hands-on experience with MLIR or another compiler framework (TVM, XLA, TorchInductor, IREE). Experience with an inference runtime or execution engine (ONNX Runtime execution providers, a custom NPU or DSP runtime). Experience with GPU compute (CUDA, OpenCL, Vulkan) or SIMD optimization on Arm or x86. Experience with large-model execution techniques such as offloading, expert caching, speculative decoding, pipelining across devices. Experience building agent environments, evaluation harnesses or verification frameworks (differential testing, regression detection), or MCP-based tooling. Location We offer a flexible working arrangement, with options to: Work from one of our Axelera AI offices (Leuven in Belgium, Amsterdam and Eindhoven in the Netherlands, Zurich in Switzerland, Florence and Milan in Italy or Bristol in the United Kingdom) if you're already based in the vicinity. Work fully remotely from any European country (incl. the UK) you are already in. Relocate with us and work from Italy (Florence or Milan) or the Netherlands (Amsterdam or Eindhoven). Kindly note that priority will be given to candidates who are [interested in being] based in Belgium or Italy. What We offer This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares. An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. review_candidates.description: SOVOS Senior HR Operations Specialist Talent·Full-Time·France/Portugal Build Your Future With Us The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions. We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive. AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. The Role At Sovos, we're building the future of global tax compliance software, and our people operations are the backbone of that mission. We're looking for a Senior HROps Specialist to own day-to-day HR operations across our European footprint, with strong working knowledge of French payroll, compliance, and employee lifecycle management. This is a high-impact role requiring both practitioner-level depth in European employment law and the operational rigour to run accurate, compliant, scalable processes across multiple jurisdictions. More Specifically, You Will Own end-to-end payroll administration for assigned European countries in partnership with ADP Celergo and regional vendors, including payroll calendars, data input quality, and post-run audit processes. Manage French payroll inputs and validation, including DSN submissions, URSSAF and social charge calculations, mutuelle and prévoyance contributions, RTT days, congés payés accrual, and 13th-month or variable pay practices under applicable collective agreements. Maintain payroll accuracy at or above 99.9%, with full cycle documentation and audit readiness, and collaborate with Finance to ensure payroll data integrity for consolidation and reporting. Maintain employee data integrity in ADP WorkforceNow for all European employee records across the full employment lifecycle, ensuring regional data flows align with global reporting standards. Support the management of benefits programmes across all active European countries, including statutory entitlements, supplemental plans, annual renewals, and broker relationships. Act as the operational compliance lead for employment law requirements across European jurisdictions, including GDPR, local statutory reporting, and France-specific obligations such as Journée de Solidarité and statutory time recording requirements. Monitor regulatory changes (new leave laws, social contribution rate adjustments, reporting mandates) and update internal processes accordingly, maintaining country-specific HR documentation and policy libraries that are audit-ready and reflect current local requirements. Support onboarding and offboarding operations for all European employees, including French DPAE filings, contract types (CDI/CDD), and compliant termination processes (rupture conventionnelle, solde de tout compte). Leverage AI tools to identify and implement automation that improves payroll, compliance, and employee lifecycle processes without sacrificing accuracy or auditability. What You Bring to Sovos You've built HR operations experience across multiple European countries, with hands-on payroll and HR administration expertise spanning diverse regulatory environments. You have working knowledge of GDPR and its operational HR implications, including data handling, employee record retention, cross-border transfers, and CNIL expectations for employee data. You're proficient with ADP Celergo or a comparable international HRIS/payroll platform, and you bring exceptional attention to detail to high-stakes data integrity work where errors carry direct legal, financial, or employee trust consequences. You anticipate operational gaps and drive continuous improvement across HR processes, identifying inefficiencies before they escalate and implementing scalable solutions without waiting for direction. You communicate clearly and effectively in English (written and verbal) and are professionally fluent in French (written and spoken), enabling you to partner effectively with global teams and local stakeholders. You apply AI-forward ways of working, building regional capability in process automation and data-driven decision-making in alignment with our AI-first strategy. Global Mentoring Programs AI Tools and Technology from Day 1 Continuous Learning and Development Language Learning Support Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs Global Parental Leave Policy Health Insurance (company paid) Life Insurance Personal Accidents Insurance Meal Allowance Flexible Benefits Platform Generous annual leave plus additional company days 13th and 14th month allowances Equal Opportunity Employer Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work. Company Background Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries. More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com. review_candidates.description: Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. POSITION SUMMARY - Preferred location for this role is Cape Town or Johannesburg, South Africa, or Nairobi, Kenya; however qualified, candidates based in any of our other CI Africa locations, including Botswana, Liberia, Angola, and Madagascar, will also be considered. CI is leading an initiative known as the ‘Keystone Protected Area Finance Initiative’ to strengthen the financial stability of Africa’s Keystone Protected Areas (KPAs). These KPAs are critical for biodiversity conservation and serve as the core of larger ecological systems in landscapes. This is achieved through technical assistance facilities/ workstreams that will develop conservation finance capacity (at the global, national, and KPA level). CI leads the strategy and management of the program, while working in partnership with co-management partners and local stakeholders to develop, execute and mobilize conservation finance transactions, resulting in financial flows to targeted KPAs during the project period. One of the key roles in achieving this effort is the Tourism Technical Assistance Facility (TAF) led by the Sr. Director: Tourism Finance. This workstream focuses on supporting tourism investment and visitation to KPAs to generate greater tourism cashflows resulting in increased revenues to these KPAs. These cashflows – largely in the form of entry, activity, lease and other fees - accrue to KPAs and may be used in support of the sustainable management of the KPA and its surrounding ecosystems. Activities under this workstream are aimed at de-risking priority tourism destinations from a private tourism sector investment perspective, by addressing key sector enablers. These enablers include land and air access, brand identity, policy, planning, and affordable finance. The Senior Director Tourism Finance will provide strategic leadership for CI's tourism workstream under KPAF initiative, overseeing the development, implementation, scaling, and continuous refinement of tourism-based conservation finance solutions across priority KPAs. Overseeing the implementation of the enabling solutions requires extensive stakeholder management at KPA level, promotion, adaptation, and supervision of technical solutions. I The role requires extensive stakeholder engagement and influence, working with tourism operators and investors, government conservation and tourism authorities, donors, development finance institutions, protected area managers, and other strategic partners to advance critical initiatives and build sustainable financing solutions. Working closely with CI's Structured Nature Finance team, the Senior Director will support the development and implementation of structured finance transactions, lead resource mobilization efforts, and represent the Keystone Protected Area Finance Initiative internally and externally. The position is also responsible for monitoring and evaluation, thought leadership, strategic communications, budgeting, and partnership development, providing a unique opportunity to shape the future of protected area finance at the intersection of tourism, conservation, and innovative finance. Oversee the selection, management and performance of strategic consulting partners and technical service providers appointed to support implementation. Provide thought leadership and regular progress updates to internal teams and senior leadership on Tourism TAF. Lead resource mobilization efforts, including developing donors, investors, and partnership opportunities to support the growth and long-term sustainability of the Tourism TAF. Develop and deliver strategic external facing materials, briefings and engagements. Maintain and engage relevant stakeholder base of KPAs, industry, investors and funders. Effectively engage stakeholders including tourism partners, protected area managers, government partners, co-management partners and other NGOs, technical colleagues, donors / funders, and other partners important to program success. Provide cross-functional leadership to ensure the Tourism TAF initiatives align with other programs initiatives and CI’s conservation and organizational priorities. In collaboration with the Structured Nature Finance lead, roll out of complimentary structured financial transactions on tourism. Ensure compliance with CI policies, funding agreements, and local requirements. Serve as a senior representative of CI building organizational visibility, influencing sector priorities and serve as a trusted point of contact for CI. People & Resource Management- Directly and indirectly supervise the Tourism TAF staff and consultants, Manage the TAF operating. Budget, Accountable for achieving TAF resource mobilization targets, Responsible for oversight of complex donor compliance obligations and funding risk management. Perform related duties as assigned. WORKING CONDITIONS Normal office environment. This is a full-time position. Frequent travel (~30%) within the Africa region will be required, often this will entail travel to remote locations with rustic conditions. Flexibility in work schedule is required to accommodate collaboration across multiple time zones with global, regional, and country teams. Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process. Work Authorization: Candidates must be legally eligible to work in one of the African countries where CI operates, without requiring work authorization or visa sponsorship. Demonstrated experience leading complex tourism, conservation or sustainable development initiatives across diverse geographies, including East and Southern Africa. Strong track record in Business development, strategic partnerships, resource mobilization and client management. Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills. Experience managing complex multi-stakeholder projects. Team player and able to work effectively with diverse works groups in a multicultural environment. Proven ability to multitask and meet priorities. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and under minimal supervision. Ability to travel to the field when needed. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluency in English required, Portuguese and or French are a bonus. Preferred Postgraduate degree in Tourism, Conservation, Business, Finance or related field.
